title: Shandeen D NDE 9588
content: I had a prescheduled surgery for November 10, 2022. There were no family or friends with me. My mom dropped me off and went home to stay with my baby. I was sitting on the hospital bed when a nurse came in and told me to change and put on the hospital gown. She came back in the room and gave me an IV. Then another nurse came in and told me she will be giving me the anesthesia into my IV. She told me I would fall asleep when I get to the surgery room. However, I was told I fell asleep before then. I remember waking up in the surgery room looking at myself on the surgery table. I wasn't hovering over my body. I was in the corner of the surgery room standing with a very bright light having a conversation. I remember hearing the thought of the doctor and him being extremely worried that something had gone terribly wrong. There were nurses in the surgery room. I was standing next to the bright light laughing and having a conversation telepathically about how the doctor and nurses thought I was dead. I guess because I had stopped breathing from sleep apnea. All I know is that nurses and the doctor was surrounding my body. I don't know for exactly how long I stopped breathing but it felt like I was on the other side for months. The light was telling me that there are a lot of people going through an awakening. The light then told me it was time for me to return. All I remember is a nurse calling my name. She repeated my name maybe 10 times. I'm not sure. I remember waking up and her being a bit scared asking me if I have sleep apnea. She was telling me that I needed to get checked out for sleep apnea. I wasn't aware that I had sleep apnea until that same day. My chest was hurting like someone had performed CPR on me. I was later told that I had been in surgery longer than I was supposed to and that my mom felt that something was wrong. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 11/10/2022 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related Life threatening event, but not clinical death Sleep Apnea How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Massive awakening I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I could zoom in on the thoughts of the doctors or nurses, I felt no pain, no worry. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was having a conversation with the bright light Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It felt like the past, present and future happening all at once. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I saw extremely well Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear telepathically Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, but the facts have not been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Very bright light that was filled with indescribable love and peace. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Maybe in a different dimension or plane. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Love, peace, joy, Happiness, Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe I understood that that world I entered seemed more real than this one. And that we shouldn't take this world so serious and to show a lot more love in this world. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future Yes Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will The light said that I had to return God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Other faiths- New age Spiritual not religious Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Other faiths- New age Spiritual not religious Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I had a OBE/NDE experience before. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Love is the answer. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin The light was brighter than the sun. It was speaking to me telepathically. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes Like I have done it plenty of times. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Yes, we are all one and connected. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes God is everything. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes Yes, all the knowledge came to me when I had the out of body experience and when the bright light spoke to me. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Uncertain Not certain During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes The light made it clear that there was life after death and we laughed how people thought death was the end. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes Yes, that we should not take this life so hard and learn to love more and laugh more. During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes The light was love and that we should love What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I'm more loving towards others and I laugh a lot more. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Being extremely conscious is hard to put into words. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience It feels like the event happened yesterday. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Clairvoyant Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Yes, when the doctor and nurses thought I was dead the light and I was laughing. The light told me not to take this life so literal. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared it with family and friends. They were open to the idea of life after death. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I had a NDE experience one other time before. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real It felt more real than this reality. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real It felt more real than this reality. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: A very bright light/presence that communicated telepathically; described as filled with "indescribable love and peace" and as a definite mystical being/voice.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as a clearly mystical/unearthly realm, possibly "a different dimension or plane," while located in the surgery room with a very bright light.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return coincided with hearing a nurse repeatedly calling her name and then waking up in the body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Prescheduled surgery; stopped breathing due to sleep apnea (life-threatening but not considered clinical death by reporter).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Telepathic awareness of the doctor's thoughts; laughter/conversation with the light while medical staff surrounded her body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Fell asleep from anesthesia, then awoke in OBE in the surgery room corner with a bright light; no tunnel; then boundary/being said it was time to return; returned upon hearing nurse calling her name.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported hearing/"zooming in" on the doctor's thoughts; described the light discussing a widespread "awakening" and laughing together about staff thinking she was dead.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "The light was telling me that there are a lot of people going through an awakening."; "The light made it clear that there was life after death and we laughed how people thought death was the end."; "The light told me not to take this life so literal."
